items.text: Ramona Bonilla-Anaiel is the Republican candidate for Cook County Commissioner in the 8th District. She is the Republican ward committeeperson for Chicago's 31st Ward. She has worked as a chief union steward for Chicago Public Schools. The SEIU board removed her as an executive in 2025 over Facebook posts it called racist, homophobic, and transphobic.
